macros.name: AndDefault
macros.doc: This macro typesets the default value of an option.

macros.name: bib
macros.doc: Typesets a BibTeX entry type.

macros.name: bib*
macros.doc: Typesets a BibTeX entry type.

macros.name: changes
macros.doc: The \changes macro provides the main interface to the change list system, and adds changes to the change list.

macros.name: cs
macros.doc: Typesets a command sequence, or macro.

macros.name: cs*
macros.doc: Typesets a command sequence, or macro.

macros.name: ctan
macros.doc: this macro defines the CTAN identifier of the package, which is (optionally) used in the \maketitle macro.

macros.name: DeclareFile
macros.doc: The \DeclareFile macro declares a file for future use with MacroCode.

macros.name: DeclareFile
macros.doc: The \DeclareFile macro declares a file for future use with MacroCode.

macros.name: DescribeEnv
macros.doc: This macro describes an environment, in the same way \DescribeMacro does for macros.

macros.name: DescribeEnv
macros.doc: This macro describes an environment, in the same way \DescribeMacro does for macros.

macros.name: DescribeFile
macros.doc: This macro describes a special file named ⟨filename⟩.

macros.name: email
macros.doc: Defines the email of the package author.

macros.name: env
macros.doc: Typesets an environment name, which will be typeset in a monospace font.

macros.name: env*
macros.doc: Typesets an environment name, which will be typeset in a monospace font.

macros.name: Finale
macros.doc: This macro indicates the end of the implementation.

macros.name: Implementation
macros.doc: This macro indicates the start of the implementation.

macros.name: LongWarning
macros.doc: The \LongWarning macro is a variant of \Warning that has been adapted for longer texts, possibly including paragraph breaks.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: The \maketitle macro typesets a title page.

macros.name: Notice
macros.doc: A notice is a short piece of text that contains information that may explain some unexpected but unharmful behaviour of a macro or similar.

macros.name: OnlyDescription
macros.doc: This macro, which should be issued in the preamble, indicates that the implementation should be hidden.

macros.name: opt
macros.doc: Typesets a package or document class option.

macros.name: opt*
macros.doc: Typesets a package or document class option.

macros.name: package
macros.doc: The \package macro defines the package name used by \thepkg, \maketitle and similar macros.

macros.name: package
macros.doc: The \package macro defines the package name used by \thepkg, \maketitle and similar macros.

macros.name: pkg
macros.doc: Typesets a package, document class or bundle name.

macros.name: pkg*
macros.doc: Typesets a package, document class or bundle name.

macros.name: PreambleTo
macros.doc: Reads the preamble from ⟨filename⟩.

macros.name: PrintChanges
macros.doc: This macro prints the list of changes.

macros.name: PrintLPPL
macros.doc: If the LPPL license is present in a directory where LaTeX can find it, in a file called lppl.tex, then \PrintLPPL will include the entire LPPL license in the document, and typeset it in a fairly compact manner.

macros.name: repository
macros.doc: this macro defines the URL of a source code repository containing a development version of the package, which is optionally used by \maketitle.

macros.name: SelfPreambleTo
macros.doc: This reads the preamble from the curent file.

macros.name: Theme
macros.doc: This macro describes a theme named ⟨theme name⟩. These could be used to describe any kind of theme, such as color themes of a document class.

macros.name: thepackage
macros.doc: The \thepackage and \thepkg macros return the package name as defined by the \package macro, enclosed in \pkg*.

macros.name: thepkg
macros.doc: The \thepackage and \thepkg macros return the package name as defined by the \package macro, enclosed in \pkg*.

macros.name: theversion
macros.doc: Returns the version as defined by \version, with a leading ‘v’.

macros.name: thm
macros.doc: Typesets a theme name.

macros.name: thm*
macros.doc: Typesets a theme name.

macros.name: version
macros.doc: Sets the version number of the package the documentation describes.

macros.name: Warning
macros.doc: A warning is a short comment that conveys information that the user must be aware of.

macros.name: WithValues
macros.doc: This macro typesets a comma-separated list of values a specific option can take.

envs.name: MacroCode
envs.doc: The class defines a MacroCode environment which substitutes the usual docstrip method of installing packages. It has the ability to generate both documentation and code in a single run of a single file.
